title: A session that cites a standing grant reads it from origin/main, not from its own checkout
why: Coordinator 16:56 CST Nov 8, its own mistake: it read the standing grants from a stale checkout (.claude/CLAUDE.md on branch lane-hold-ends-on-cause) and told triage that a Mac session could close PRs. Main's grant "acts the cloud refuses" names only two acts. Triage caught it at 16:55 CST. Harm: a session acts, or asks another session to act, on a grant the owner never gave. Fix shape: when a session cites a standing grant, it reads it with `git show origin/main:.claude/CLAUDE.md`, or the session-start hook warns when the checkout's .claude/CLAUDE.md differs from origin/main's. Red case: a checkout whose .claude/CLAUDE.md differs from origin/main gets the warning.
note: Scope added (owner ask ask-mw8gfqzlws, coordinator fold 17:20 CST Nov 8): one `git fetch --prune origin` at session start, with a timeout, reading unknown on failure. Read at 17:23 CST on main 2ac382cc6: hooks/session_start.sh already fetches through bounded_fetch (2 s bound, CLAUDE_SETTINGS_FETCH_TIMEOUT), but only when the session sits on the default branch, so a lane on its own branch never fetches; that matches the Banchi case (local origin/main 78398f4, GitHub 40483e3). Extend bounded_fetch, its one home, rather than add a second hook. The ask also wants: report (never move) a local main that differs from origin/main, report how far the current branch is behind, about 20 s timeout, no checkout/restore/reset/stash, no change to existing guards; red cases: stale origin/main on a non-default branch gets the new sha, and an offline session still starts. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was archived, handoff at handoffs/session_013NEJKzp1xjTHtzDvmMRpKj.md on archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10). Closed 13:47 CST Nov 12: already on origin/main via 6581fafdb (PR #2493 merged into batch 72); hooks/session_start.sh compares each grant file with origin/main (block headed "Step grants-read-from-main"). Found by triage's sizing read, checked by triage. Coordinator 14:06 CST: lane grants-stale-on-windows built nothing; cause needs a Windows run. Read-only check mailed to the Windows helper (msg 66765d83781f, 14:04). Candidates: (a) installed hook copy behind main (folds into cloud-hooks-stale-copy), (b) the 10 s SessionStart timeout kills session_start.sh before the grant block, (c) the warning printed unread. Waits on that reply. Lane grants-hook-timeout started 14:22 CST Nov 12. Done: #2978 merged in batch 130 (main 7dd44c41c, 09:29 CST Nov 13). Lane session_013NEJL1m68NUQyPRVp9D8e6 to archive.
